rounds.text: Luxury Time Ltd trades at a compelling single-digit P/E of 9.25x [E1] and 8.88x against a sector benchmark of 28.09x [E6], offering deep value against its peers. This valuation disconnect stands in stark contrast to the company's superior profitability, highlighted by a robust ROCE of 20.84% to 25.3% [E9, E10] and an ROE of 15.82% to 19.9% [E8, E11], both comfortably outperforming their respective sector benchmarks [E8, E9, E52]. Operational efficiency is expanding, evidenced by operating margins climbing 4 percentage points over three years to 12% in March 2026 [E18], alongside compounding profit growth of 32% over the trailing twelve months [E15]. The balance sheet remains pristine with a debt-to-equity ratio of just 0.05x [E25] and positive free cash flow of Rs 0.32 Cr [E23], supported further by a consumer durables sector tailwind score of +0.92 [E48]. Conceded: institutional money flow reads negative with a holding change of -5.47 percentage points [E32], and debtor days have increased to 69.8 days [E40].
